title: Folding Chair of the Mangled Foot

html:
Folding Chair of the Mangled Foot
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  One-handed Mace
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Folding Chair of the Mangled Foot is a fighter one-handed mace.

This rainbow is specific to Manglefeet's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

You have to be 80 for this named roll, on the chest or out of the Wishing Well. There is no maximum. A 100 still gets it. Levels for the other lair pieces are on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Endurance
  • + Strength
  • + Shadow Damage
  • + Melee Attack Rating
  • + Total Health
  • + Crushing Damage

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
